trigger: Postgres degrade -> mass fail-closed SAML/OIDC deny, no alert rule on yuzu_auth_{oidc,saml}_deprovisioned_denied_total
summary: No Prometheus alert rule for either deprovisioned_denied counter; a login-availability signal riding a security counter is invisible during a PG outage. Identical gap shipped in merged OIDC PR3; covers both counters. Non-blocking (SHOULD).

trigger: Operator rotates --saml-idp-entity-id / --oidc-issuer; identity_links keyed on old value -> new lookup 0 rows -> no-link->proceed -> pre-rotation-deprovisioned identity admitted; undocumented
summary: Trust-anchor rotation orphans identity links (entity_id/iss-keyed); the deny-at-login backstop is blind to a pre-rotation-deprovisioned identity and cannot re-arm via SCIM (relink needs an active resource). Undocumented security-relevant behaviour -> I7 raised HIGH. Verified symmetric with merged OIDC PR3. FIXED: honest residual caveat added to docs/auth-architecture.md, Gate-8 security-guardian re-review PASS (truth + non-harmful mitigation confirmed).

trigger: SAML login flood; up to 4 scim_store pool acquisitions per login (helper x2, each accessor + reprovision query) -> pool exhaustion -> cascading fail-closed denials
summary: 2-4x scim_store pool acquisitions per SAML login under the deny path; amplification identical to OIDC PR3. Non-blocking capacity item.

trigger: Transient PG blip on post-mint re-check -> fail-closed deny -> invalidate_user_sessions(saml_principal) erases ALL that user's sessions, not only the minted one
summary: invalidate_user_sessions is invalidate-all by design (inherited from OIDC). A blip during one SAML re-login logs the user out of all devices. Fail-closed direction; non-blocking.

trigger: Orphaned link (active=nullopt) + the reprovision query find_unique_active_by_external_id itself hits a store error (nullopt indistinguishable from no-sibling) -> deny labeled linked_scim_resource_inactive not scim_store_unavailable
summary: Audit-label imprecision on a double-store-error in the orphaned branch. Defensible (the primary linked resource IS gone/inactive), deny is correctly fail-closed; only the reprovision-confirmation is uncertain. Inherited from OIDC. Non-blocking.

trigger: Sessions are in-memory-only post-PG-migration; invalidate_user_sessions never writes a DB, so db_persisted is always true and the ;db_persisted=false audit branch is effectively dead
summary: db_persisted=false post-mint branch is dead (in-memory sessions). Mirrors OIDC. Also noted by authdb. Latent/no-op; NICE.
